::: {#hero-heading}
I work specifically at the sss [Équipe de Recherche sur le Processus Innovatifs[^1] --ERPI--](https://erpi.univ-lorraine.fr/) and teach at the [École Nationale Supérieure en Génie des Systèmes et de l'Innovation [^2] --ENSGSI--](https://ensgsi.univ-lorraine.fr/nos-formations/) at Nancy - France.

My research is developed at the [Lorraine Fab Living Lab Platform](https://lf2l.fr/) on projects related to the concept of **Distributed Recycling for Additive Manufacturing (DRAM)** for circular economy perspectives valuing the junction between *open source* tools, social innovation spaces, holistic indicators. 
I hope this research contributes to way to put in place sustainability approaches for a post-growth scenarios.

[Learn more about my research &rarr;](/about){.about-links .subtitle}

:::


[^1]: Research team on Innovation Process -ERPI- Laboratory
[^2]:  National School in Industrial Systems Engineering and Innovation
